messages:
tian: quick ping — PR #2146 updates the SDK streaming client + tool-calling handler, need a quick review before EOW. main changes: streaming reconnect/backpressure + function-call schema tweaks. diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/2146  cc @alex @jordan

alex: on it, will take a look later today. any specific smoke tests you want me to run?

tian: thanks — run `make test-integration STREAM=true` then `./tools/call-demo --bot` to hit the function-call path. set `REDWOOD_ENV=staging` if you're running telemetry.

jordan: skimmed the diff — overall looks clean but one thing: in stream.Read loop we swallow ErrClosed and map to generic errors, might hide reconnect intent. left an inline comment. pinging @sara for backpressure/retry guidance.

sara: I can review. reconnect delay should be jittered — last quarter we hit tight retry storms. use `base*2^n + rand(0,100ms)` or the existing jitter util. also check that maxInFlight is honored during reconnect.

alex: saw CI failing on macos-latest for signal handling in the test harness. reproduces locally for me; pushing a tiny patch to the handler and will rerun.

deploy-bot: CI / build #2146 — macos-latest failed (signal-handling). :arrow_forward: queued rerun by alex.

maria: if we can get approvals by EOD Thursday i'll schedule merge for Friday morning. thanks for the heads-up. :calendar:

jordan: added request for a small unit test for reconnect backoff in the PR comments. otherwise LGTM once CI is green.

alex: rerun passed, macos green. addressed signal handler in commit 3f7a2b; pushed.

tian: amazing — thanks everyone. i'll squash+merge after we get the approvals. tagging this thread on the PR and will post a quick changelog in #eng-releases after merge. :tada:
